title: HB 2701 (2021 - Fifty-fifth Legislature - First Regular Session (azleg session id 123)): polling places; identification; early voting
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id)
(section) Bill text
(quote) REFERENCE TITLE: polling places; identification; early voting
(section) Sec. 1: Subject to the requirements of article IV, part 1, section 1, Constitution of Arizona, section 16-166, Arizona (para E)
(quote) E. The county recorder on or before May 1 of each year preceding a state primary and general election or more frequently as the recorder deems necessary may use the change of address information supplied by the postal service through its licensees to identify registrants whose addresses may have changed.
(section) Sec. 1: Subject to the requirements of article IV, part 1, section 1, Constitution of Arizona, section 16-166, Arizona (para 3)
(quote) 3. A legible photocopy of pertinent pages of the applicant's United States passport identifying the applicant and the applicant's passport number or presentation to the county recorder of the applicant's United States passport.
(section) Sec. 2: Section 16-411, Arizona Revised Statutes, is amended to read: (para 3)
(quote) A voting center shall allow any voter in that county to receive the appropriate ballot for that voter on election day after presenting identification as prescribed in section 16‑579 and to lawfully cast the ballot.
(section) Sec. 4: Subject to the requirements of article IV, part 1, section 1, Constitution of Arizona, section 16-579, Arizona
(quote) only a valid form of identification that bears the photograph, name and address of the elector that reasonably appear to be the same as the name and address in the precinct register, including an Arizona driver license, an Arizona nonoperating identification license, a tribal enrollment card or other form of tribal identification or a United States federal, state or local government issued identification.
(section) Sec. 5: Section 28-3153, Arizona Revised Statutes, is amended to read: (para 1)
(quote) 1. Proof of identity by presenting an ORIGINAL or certified copy of a United States passport or birth certificate.
(b_no_id_remedy)
(section) Sec. 4: Subject to the requirements of article IV, part 1, section 1, Constitution of Arizona, section 16-579, Arizona (para 2)
(quote) 2. If the elector does not present identification that complies with paragraph 1 of this subsection, the elector is only eligible to vote a provisional ballot as prescribed by section 16‑584 or a conditional provisional ballot as provided for in the secretary of state's instruction and procedures manual adopted pursuant to section 16‑452.
(section) Sec. 5: Section 28-3153, Arizona Revised Statutes, is amended to read: (para D)
(quote) D. Notwithstanding any other law, the department shall not issue to or renew a driver license or nonoperating identification license for a person who does not submit proof satisfactory to the department that the applicant's presence in the United States is authorized under federal law as PRESCRIBED by subsection E of this section.
(section) Sec. 5: Section 28-3153, Arizona Revised Statutes, is amended to read: (para D)
(quote) For an application for a driver license or a nonoperating identification license, the department shall not accept as a primary source of identification a driver license issued by a state if the state does not require that a driver licensed in that state be lawfully present in the United States under federal law.
(c_mail_ballot_id)
(section) Sec. 2: Section 16-411, Arizona Revised Statutes, is amended to read:
(quote) (b) A qualified elector voting at an emergency voting center shall provide identification as prescribed in section 16‑579, except that notwithstanding section 16‑579, subsection A, paragraph 2, for any voting at an emergency voting center, the county recorder or other officer in charge of elections may allow a qualified elector to update the elector's voter registration information as provided for in the secretary of state's instructions and procedures manual adopted pursuant to section 16‑452.
(d_proof_of_citizenship)
(section) Sec. 1: Subject to the requirements of article IV, part 1, section 1, Constitution of Arizona, section 16-166, Arizona (para F)
(quote) F. The county recorder shall reject any application for registration that is not accompanied by satisfactory evidence of United States citizenship.
(section) Sec. 1: Subject to the requirements of article IV, part 1, section 1, Constitution of Arizona, section 16-166, Arizona (para F)
(quote) Satisfactory evidence of citizenship shall include any of the following:
(section) Sec. 1: Subject to the requirements of article IV, part 1, section 1, Constitution of Arizona, section 16-166, Arizona (para 1)
(quote) 1. The number of the applicant's driver license or nonoperating identification license issued after October 1, 1996 by the department of transportation or the equivalent governmental agency of another state within the United States if the agency indicates on the applicant's driver license or nonoperating identification license that the person has provided satisfactory proof of United States citizenship.
(section) Sec. 1: Subject to the requirements of article IV, part 1, section 1, Constitution of Arizona, section 16-166, Arizona (para 2)
(quote) 2. A legible photocopy of the applicant's birth certificate that verifies citizenship to the satisfaction of the county recorder.
(section) Sec. 1: Subject to the requirements of article IV, part 1, section 1, Constitution of Arizona, section 16-166, Arizona (para 4)
(quote) If only the number of the certificate of naturalization is provided, the applicant shall not be included in the registration rolls until the number of the certificate of naturalization is verified with the United States citizenship and immigration services by the county recorder.
(section) Sec. 1: Subject to the requirements of article IV, part 1, section 1, Constitution of Arizona, section 16-166, Arizona (para G)
(quote) G. Notwithstanding subsection F of this section, any person who is registered in this state on the effective date of this amendment to this section is deemed to have provided satisfactory evidence of citizenship and shall not be required to resubmit evidence of citizenship unless the person is changing voter registration from one county to another.
(section) Sec. 1: Subject to the requirements of article IV, part 1, section 1, Constitution of Arizona, section 16-166, Arizona (para H)
(quote) H. For the purposes of this section, proof of voter registration from another state or county is not satisfactory evidence of citizenship.
(section) Sec. 1: Subject to the requirements of article IV, part 1, section 1, Constitution of Arizona, section 16-166, Arizona (para I)
(quote) I. A person who modifies voter registration records with a new residence ballot shall not be required to submit evidence of citizenship.
(section) Sec. 1: Subject to the requirements of article IV, part 1, section 1, Constitution of Arizona, section 16-166, Arizona (para I)
(quote) After citizenship has been demonstrated to the county recorder, the person is not required to resubmit satisfactory evidence of citizenship in that county.
(section) Sec. 1: Subject to the requirements of article IV, part 1, section 1, Constitution of Arizona, section 16-166, Arizona (para J)
(quote) J. After a person has submitted satisfactory evidence of citizenship, the county recorder shall indicate this information in the person's permanent voter file.
(section) Sec. 1: Subject to the requirements of article IV, part 1, section 1, Constitution of Arizona, section 16-166, Arizona (para J)
(quote) After two years the county recorder may destroy all documents that were submitted as evidence of citizenship.END_STATUTE
(e_other_rule)
(section) Sec. 1: Subject to the requirements of article IV, part 1, section 1, Constitution of Arizona, section 16-166, Arizona (para 7)
(quote) 7. an identification card that is issued by this state or the United States.
(section) Sec. 4: Subject to the requirements of article IV, part 1, section 1, Constitution of Arizona, section 16-579, Arizona
(quote) Identification is deemed valid unless it can be determined on its face that it has expired.
(section) Sec. 5: Section 28-3153, Arizona Revised Statutes, is amended to read:
(quote) Driver license issuance; prohibitions
(section) Sec. 5: Section 28-3153, Arizona Revised Statutes, is amended to read: (para 1)
(quote) 1. A driver license to a person who is under eighteen years of age, except that the department may issue:
(section) Sec. 5: Section 28-3153, Arizona Revised Statutes, is amended to read: (para 6)
(quote) 6. A class A, B or C license to a person who has been disqualified from obtaining a commercial driver license.
(section) Sec. 5: Section 28-3153, Arizona Revised Statutes, is amended to read: (para 12)
(quote) A license to a person whose driver license has been ordered to be suspended for failure to pay child support, except that a noncommercial restricted license may be issued pursuant to section 25‑518.
(section) Sec. 5: Section 28-3153, Arizona Revised Statutes, is amended to read: (para B)
(quote) B. The department shall not issue a driver license to or renew the driver license of the following persons:
(other) Sec. 3: Section 16-541, Arizona Revised Statutes, is amended to read:
(other) Sec. 6: Requirements for enactment; three-fourths vote
